name: moderation-bot
description: Production-ready Discord moderation bot (discord.js v14) with Cloudflare D1 storage behind a Worker API gateway.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run selftest && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:schema:local: cd cloudflare/worker && npx wrangler d1 execute moderation --local --file=../schema.sql
scripts.db:schema:remote: cd cloudflare/worker && npx wrangler d1 execute moderation --remote --file=../schema.sql
